```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(shiny)
library(readr)
library(vip)
library(janitor)
library(forcats)
library(tidymodels)
library(tidyverse)
library(modelr)
library(readxl)
library(broom)
library(ggfortify)
library(performance)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(skimr)
library(rsample)
library(themis)
library(yardstick)
library(xgboost)
library(bslib)
library(shinydashboard)
library(shinythemes)
library(knitr)
library(stringr)
library(shinyjs)
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(glue)

stroke_risk <- reactiveVal(0)

dataRaw <- read_csv("healthcare.csv")
dataClean <- dataRaw %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    ever_married    = if_else(ever_married == "Yes", 1L, 0L),
    residence_type  = if_else(residence_type == "Urban", 1L, 0L),
    gender          = if_else(gender == "Male", 1L, 0L),
    stroke          = factor(stroke, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    work_type       = as.factor(work_type),
    smoking_status  = as.factor(smoking_status),
    bmi             = as.numeric(na_if(bmi, "N/A"))
  )

dataClean2 <- dataClean %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  filter(smoking_status != "Unknown")

set.seed(123)
splits <- initial_split(dataClean2, strata = stroke)
dataClean_other <- training(splits)

lr_workflow_best <- readRDS("lr_model.rds")
rf_workflow_best <- readRDS("rf_model.rds")
xgb_workflow_best <- readRDS("xgb_model.rds")

lr_last_fit <- lr_workflow_best %>% last_fit(splits)
rf_last_fit <- rf_workflow_best %>% last_fit(splits)
xgb_last_fit <- xgb_workflow_best %>% last_fit(splits)
```

Prediction Gauge + Message
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
observeEvent(input$predict, {
  new_data <- tibble(
    id = 9999,
    age = input$age,
    avg_glucose_level = input$glucose,
    bmi = input$bmi,
    gender = as.integer(input$gender),
    smoking_status = factor(input$smoking, levels = levels(dataClean$smoking_status)),
    work_type = factor(input$work, levels = levels(dataClean$work_type)),
    residence_type = as.integer(input$residence),
    ever_married = as.integer(input$married),
    hypertension = 0,
    heart_disease = 0
  )

  model <- xgb_workflow_best %>% fit(dataClean_other)
  prediction <- predict(model, new_data, type = "prob")
  prob <- round(prediction$.pred_Yes * 100, 1)

  stroke_risk(prob)
})

output$prediction_gauge <- renderGauge({
  prob <- stroke_risk()

  gauge(prob,
        min = 0, max = 100, symbol = '%',
        gaugeSectors(success = c(0, 20), warning = c(20, 50), danger = c(50, 100))
  )
})

output$prediction_text <- renderUI({
  prob <- stroke_risk()
  message <- case_when(
    prob >= 80 ~ "🚨 Danger zone! Cancel your bungee jump.",
    prob >= 50 ~ "⚠️ Hmm... It's not a bad idea to visit a doctor.",
    prob >= 20 ~ "🙂 You're doing okay. Keep it up!",
    TRUE       ~ "🎉 Safe for now — celebrate with an oily pizza and a Diet Coke."
  )

  HTML(glue::glue(
    "<div style='margin-top:20px; font-size:20px; color:#FDF7F7; text-align:center;'>
      {message}<br><span style='font-size:24px; font-weight:bold;'>{prob}%</span>
    </div>"
  ))
})
```

```{r}
gaugeOutput("prediction_gauge", height = "300px")
htmlOutput("prediction_text")
```
